attack: Treat every listed logical category as a separate canonical member.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Sidecar/file/join explosion; multiple corruption and reconstruction boundaries.
round1_evidence: R01 bounded simplicity; R02 direct-storage fallback; R06 non-additive law
required_correction: Convert to information-owner account; co-locate unless separation earns its cost.

attack: Normalize/default/tier the same field three ways.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Reconstruction labyrinth and exception synchronization.
required_correction: Choose at most one compaction mechanism per field unless independent named gates require more.

attack: Typed lanes x adaptive codecs x vector invariants x source-local compilers.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Compiler/test cross-product can hide one rare source-state loss.
required_correction: Exact fixed lanes first; vectorization orthogonal; adaptive/source specialization deferred.

attack: Question blocks + bitmaps + late materialization + hybrid dense/explicit.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Multiple incidence representations; cache/projection can become ontology.
required_correction: Court QBL and HYBRID separately with zero persistent cache; add late materialization only if needed.

attack: Cache repeated identity/derivation by default.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Stale determinant set can fabricate valid-looking C11 identity; unnecessary invalidation state.
round1_evidence: R03 RT21/22; R05 cache law; R06 C04
required_correction: Zero-cache baseline; add only for measured recomputation bottleneck with full key closure.

attack: Use bitmap/index presence as predicate support.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Unindexed high-cardinality/unseen I05 candidates become unreachable.
required_correction: Cacheless canonical scan path is mandatory; bitmap is disposable speed only.

attack: Filter/materialize values before routing/authority/negative-state resolution.
destruction_or_bloat_path: UNAVAILABLE/INAPPLICABLE/ROUTING_UNKNOWN collapses into empty/zero.
required_correction: Resolve authority/risk/routing/negative requirements before pruning.

attack: Optimize fast marginals and ignore k-way joins.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Question blocks starve arbitrary conjunctions and blind I05.
round1_evidence: R04 benchmark Q4-Q17/D1-D8; R06 query-risk map
required_correction: Decision benchmark must include multi-block, k-way, NOT, routing, recursive, branch and blind workloads.

attack: Assume respondent x canonical-question rectangularity.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Repeated/ranked/component/MR events overwrite each other.
required_correction: Dense only under exact certificate; explicit-event escape total and canonical.

attack: Use physical position or compact carrier ordinal as logical identity.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Repartition/row-group/thread changes mutate replay identity.
round1_evidence: R02 locator ledger; R03 H031; R06 I02/I13
required_correction: Only immutable source coordinates/exact refs may determine semantic identity.

attack: Dispatch physical meaning by source family.
destruction_or_bloat_path: New source creates new semantic branch; downstream behavior diverges.
round1_evidence: R03 A23; R04 attack 8; Authority 54 C
required_correction: Capability-derived execution only; source family invisible to C11/I03/I05/I04 meaning.

attack: Move provenance/topology/routing/weights to cold tier then optimize hot-only path.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Fast path cannot close exact negative/replay/discovery evidence without hidden joins.
required_correction: No hot/cold baseline; if later used, one root and every dependency remains query-visible.

attack: Add Merkle hierarchy because partial verification is modern/efficient.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Extra schema/version/hash/recovery states without query-sufficiency proof.
round1_evidence: R05 deepest failure; R06 integrity ornamentation
required_correction: Flat root/member first; hierarchy only after named partial verification/fetch/repair boundary fails.

attack: Parallelize before serial bounded determinism.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Queue/compressor RSS and merge schedule alter output/order; debugging surface expands.
required_correction: Serial bounded baseline; parallel only after frozen wall-time failure and 1/2/N determinism court.

attack: Choose per-variable codecs from observed range/frequency.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Sample-dependent/nondeterministic policy plus type/missingness cross-product.
required_correction: Fixed exact lanes and standard tuning first; no sampled semantic narrowing.

attack: Lift fields because values are equal in current scan.
destruction_or_bloat_path: WVS raw-identical/dictionary-distinct and zero-incidence declarations are destroyed.
required_correction: Exact determinant/grain/exception certificate or direct storage.

attack: Default from majority/first-seen value and store exceptions.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Rare declaration/topology/authority variation can disappear.
required_correction: Default is only an encoding of independently proven determinant; direct storage if exception law complex.

attack: Interpret separate logical states as requiring separate physical relations.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Three side relations for physical/semantic/routing state can add joins without protection.
required_correction: Keep separate typed fields/vocabularies; co-location in long shard is lawful if no inference occurs.

attack: Create canonical completeness index for every negative query.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Another canonical structure/invalidation path even though verified shard inventory + exhaustive scan may suffice.
required_correction: No separate index baseline; add only if inventory/traversal cannot prove exhaustive domain.

attack: Let content-addressed root self-authorize or select newest root.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Valid stale/malicious root can serve.
required_correction: Explicit trusted active selector + CAS; content hash authenticates content only.

attack: Retain old root and silently fail back after promotion.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Two empirical authorities persist in practice.
required_correction: No automatic fallback; bounded shadow only; explicit fresh rebuild/rollback governance.

attack: Adopt R04 >=2x or ~35% relative speedup rule.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Complex design can win while simpler already satisfies every required boundary; local metrics ignore proof/recovery burden.
round1_evidence: R04 explicitly nonbinding threshold; R03 performance bargaining; R06 stop rule
required_correction: Freeze absolute boundaries before results; choose first sufficient candidate by minimality.

attack: Count only canonical payload bytes.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Cost migrates into cache, scratch, sidecars, rebuild, joins, integrity, and operator burden.
round1_evidence: R05 storage accounting; R06 resource model
required_correction: Report canonical, staging, scratch, cache, post-success, per-phase RSS/runtime and complexity surfaces separately.

attack: Use warm-cache or known I05 workload as organization selector.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Storage is tuned to the court and finite vocabulary appears general.
required_correction: Candidate/tuning freeze precedes blind I05 frontier; organization selection uses no-cache results.

attack: Give each organization a different favorable acceptance harness.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Shared defects hidden; metrics incomparable; special path becomes semantic branch.
required_correction: One source-neutral runner and one receipt schema for all candidates.

attack: Trust candidate-emitted semantic hashes/counts after constructor bypass.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Fast and reference paths can share the same omission.
required_correction: Independent hash/projection/set-incidence verifier and hostile sensitivity cases.

attack: Interpret one-copy so literally that no shadow can be built for equivalence.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Migration becomes impossible or requires mutating active truth.
round1_evidence: R05 migration open boundary; Authority 54 shadow law
required_correction: Allow exactly one non-serving shadow during bounded court; one serving authority always.

attack: Declare O(N) scans a performance failure without an absolute requirement.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Premature QBL/bitmap/hybrid escalation.
required_correction: O(N) is acceptable if it satisfies pre-frozen practical boundaries.

attack: Treat clustering as a new semantic schema.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Unneeded duplicated metadata/materializers and profile branching.
round1_evidence: R04 question-block design; Authority 54 organization list
required_correction: Same logical event schema and C11 materializer; only physical shard locality changes.

attack: Allow dense fallback selection by source family or observed regularity.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Unproved geometry erases events; family identity becomes semantics.
required_correction: Dense selection only from exact immutable geometry/grain certificate; otherwise explicit.

attack: Build an observability framework as part of carrier.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Maintenance dependency unrelated to empirical truth.
required_correction: Fixed boring receipts only.

attack: Keep every mechanism that passes its local proof.
destruction_or_bloat_path: Six-cell proposals become additive shopping list and permanent architecture tax.
required_correction: Final deletion pass: remove any mechanism whose deletion leaves every boundary passing.
